claims.claim: Cam Skattebo is a running back for the New York Giants, wearing No. 44, listed at 5-11 and 215 lb
claims.note: Profile and roster page show RB, #44, 5-11, 215 lbs; 5 ft 11 in and 97.5 kg are conversions.

claims.claim: Drafted by the Giants in the 4th round, 105th overall, in 2025
Started at Sacramento State before transferring to Arizona State
claims.note: Arizona Sports: made his name at Sacramento State before transferring to ASU; Giants.com draft piece covers both schools.

claims.claim: Born and raised in Rio Linda, California, just north of Sacramento (birthPlace fact)
claims.note: Official profile: 'Was born and raised in Rio Linda, California, which is just north of Sacramento.' No birth date or nationality on the page, so neither is stated.

claims.claim: Told Giants.com he was 'someone that's gonna score a lot of touchdowns'
claims.note: Quote confirmed. The 'hard runner' phrase and the April 2025 date were not in the source and were removed.

claims.claim: 2025: 8 games, 101 carries, 410 rushing yards, 5 rushing TDs, 24 receptions, 207 receiving yards, 2 receiving TDs
2026: 7 games, 98 carries, 418 rushing yards, 2 rushing TDs, 11 receptions, 76 receiving yards
Two-season totals: 199 carries, 828 rushing yards, 7 rushing TDs
Fined for illegal helmet contact on a running play in the Week 3 win over Tennessee; Jordan Raanan of ESPN reported it
claims.note: Newsweek names Raanan and quotes the reason; Week 3 win over Tennessee.

claims.claim: No flag was thrown on the field; the play was referred after the game to the Football Operations Compliance Team; violation 'Unnecessary roughness (use of the helmet on offense)'
claims.note: AtoZ: officials did not throw a flag; the league's officiating department reviews every play and refers violations to the compliance team; violation text matches. The 'after the game' timing is inferred from the fine coming later.

claims.claim: Jeffery Simmons: 'I think a couple times he did lower his helmet'
claims.note: Quote matches Newsweek, which quotes Simmons.

claims.claim: League typically fines $23,882 for illegal helmet use, $47,762 for a second offense
AtoZ Sports put the fine at $7,073; Newsweek did not confirm that amount
claims.note: AtoZ lists 'RB Cam Skattebo: $7,073'. Newsweek does not state the amount for Skattebo.

claims.claim: After a fumble against Washington, no carries in the 34-27 loss to New Orleans; Tracy, Singletary and Harris took the carries
claims.note: Tracy 6, Singletary 4, Harris 4 carries; Skattebo had none.

claims.claim: Skattebo said 'I got punished for what I did'
claims.note: Quote matches; the source continues '(last week), and I understand', which the page trims without changing meaning.

claims.claim: Report does not say whether he was inactive, nor link the benching to the helmet fine; Houston game outcome unknown
Summary, knownFor, meta and FAQ answers repeat the verified facts above
claims.note: Each answer is backed by the body and sources above.

valueNote: Uses the official Giants profile for birthplace and the official roster and draft pages for stats. Gives the helmet fine's amount only as a reported figure, and flags that the other outlet does not confirm it.
summary: en: all cited claims were confirmed against the opened sources. Birth date and nationality are left out because the official profile does not give them.
